name: Hora retro desktop typing
pose: Forward V, requested total 70 degrees. Illustrated approximation, not a measured skeletal angle.
prompts:
Edit the supplied Hora typing sprite sheet. This is the EDIT TARGET, not just a style reference. Keep the same character identity, navy bob with gold feather tips, Horus eye ahoge and separate blue orb, folded navy-gold wings, ivory Egyptian outfit, sandals, rear view, polished chibi anime rendering and transparent background.

Change ONLY the computer equipment and seated leg pose in BOTH frames:
1. Replace the laptop entirely with an early-2000s retro beige desktop PC setup: a very bulky deep CRT monitor with a curved glass screen and thick plastic bezel, a separate beige tower computer case with front ventilation, power button and CD-ROM drive, and a separate chunky wired full-size beige keyboard. The CRT must visibly have a deep heavy housing, NOT a flat panel or laptop. Arrange these on the floor immediately in front of her, monitor slightly offset so its screen and deep side are readable over/beside her shoulder; tower beside it. Hands type on the separate keyboard, not on the monitor. Abstract cyan screen content only, no brand or readable text.
2. Her legs extend FORWARD from her seated hips toward the computer, spreading in a V with a TOTAL included angle of 70 degrees between the two leg centre-lines, i.e. about 35 degrees left and right from the forward centre-line. Much narrower than the almost sideways split in the input. Knees gently relaxed, feet in front of her hips, legs not crossed or folded. Show this anatomically with an elevated rear camera angle. Keep the outfit modest and fully covered. Do not draw angle labels or guides.

Production layout: exactly TWO equal square frames, side-by-side on one 2:1 transparent canvas. The whole girl + CRT + tower + keyboard must fit entirely inside each square with transparent margin. In both frames lock the camera, scale, placement, leg angle, computer, wings, head and floor baseline in the SAME position relative to each cell. ONLY alternate the hands between adjacent keyboard positions: first left hand down/right hand slightly up, second right hand down/left hand slightly up. This will be a two-frame looping typing animation. No frame borders, no text, no background, no floor plane, no drop shadow. Preserve actual alpha transparency.

Targeted correction of this TWO-FRAME Hora sprite sheet. Preserve the beautiful early-2000s beige CRT monitor, tower case, separate keyboard, Hora's appearance, transparent background and two-frame 2:1 layout. The current picture hides the LEFT LEG, so the intended 70-degree V cannot be seen. Fix this.

Use a more elevated REAR camera, looking down at roughly 50 degrees. Place Hora centered in the lower middle of EACH square, with BOTH short legs and BOTH sandal-clad feet clearly visible in front of her, one on each side of the keyboard. The left leg must visibly extend toward the upper LEFT from her seated hips, and the right leg toward the upper RIGHT. They form a moderate 70-degree total V (35 degrees from forward for each leg), not a sideways split, and not just one visible foot. Slightly reduce the wings' spread and head scale if necessary to reveal both legs, without changing her chibi identity or outfit. CRT and tower sit farther forward above the keyboard, with the CRT body visibly deep and bulky. Hands reach the keyboard; the second frame has only a tiny hand movement, all other pixels/composition should remain as registered as possible. Keep the whole scene at least 6 percent away from every cell edge; especially the tower on the right must NOT touch or be cut off by either frame edge. Both cells exactly equal squares. No labels, no drawn angles, no background, no ground shadow. Match the original clean navy/gold/ivory anime rendering. This is an animated web sprite asset.

Make a precise pose correction ONLY to the two-frame sprite sheet provided. Keep exactly this Hora, the bulky beige retro CRT desktop PC, separate tower and keyboard, navy and gold style, alpha transparency, and two equal square frames side by side. The current legs still spread much too wide, like a near sideways split. NARROW THE LEGS SIGNIFICANTLY to a total 70-degree V, with both legs stretched FORWARD toward the monitor. Bring BOTH feet closer together and much farther forward/up in the picture. Do NOT merely move the toes: rotate each whole leg inward from the hip, with knees and ankles following. Both feet must remain visible.

Composition guide for EACH square (do NOT draw the guide): the apparent common seated hip origin near x=43%, y=83%; left foot around x=23%, y=54%; right foot around x=63%, y=54%. This makes the projected included angle approximately 70 degrees. Leg axes run from the hip toward those feet. Feet are roughly at keyboard height, not beside the bottom of the skirt. Adjust occlusion minimally so both sandals are visible on either side, use a slightly higher rear viewing angle if needed. Preserve modest coverage and dress, small folded wings, and all computer details. This is a natural seated forward V pose, NOT a side split and NOT cross-legged. Exact same whole composition in both frames except tiny alternating typing-hand motion. Keep all objects fully inside each frame with transparent padding. Do not zoom or crop. No labels, no background, no shadows.

Create a transparent TWO-FRAME sprite sheet of Hora typing on a retro desktop PC. Use image 1 ONLY for Hora's character identity and rendering style. Use image 2 ONLY for the beige CRT, tower and keyboard design, NOT its body pose. REDRAW THE SEATED POSE.

Camera: elevated, centered directly BEHIND Hora, looking down. She sits symmetrically on the floor facing away, both legs straight ahead in a moderate V, total angle about 70 degrees. BOTH legs and BOTH sandal-clad feet MUST be clearly visible, on either side of her body. Never omit the left leg. The legs point diagonally FORWARD, not sideways. Her little folded wings are small and do not obscure the legs. Hair must not hide either foot. She has a navy bob, gold feather tips, Egyptian ivory dress, navy/gold wings, gold sandals, a Horus-eye hair curl containing a separate floating blue orb. Match identity exactly. Modest fully covered outfit.

A thick bulky beige CRT monitor sits directly in front of her, tall enough for its screen and deep case to show ABOVE her head; a separate beige tower with CD drive stands beside it, and a separate beige keyboard lies between her forward legs. Both hands type on the keyboard. No laptop. This is a clear centered rear-view composition: left foot and right foot clearly visible as a pair around the keyboard. If needed make her head slightly smaller to keep both legs visible.

Layout: 2 identical square cells in one horizontal 2:1 canvas with transparent background. EXACTLY identical scene in both cells except the small typing motion of the hands, one lifted in frame one, the other in frame two. Fix the head, legs, equipment and camera between frames to avoid jitter. Entire PC and girl fit inside each cell with margin; no cropping or overlap. No labels, words, frame outlines, floor, background, cast shadow. Actual alpha. Clean anime sprite.

Edit only the LEGS in BOTH frames of this transparent sprite. Keep all character and computer artwork, sizes, keyboard, CRT, tower, colors, transparency and two-frame layout exactly unchanged.
The legs are far too wide. Bring the feet dramatically CLOSER TOGETHER, toward the keyboard. The knees point forward at the computer. Her legs must NOT extend horizontally toward the left and right borders. Rotate both legs inward substantially. Left sandal should appear just below the LEFT end of the keyboard, right sandal just below the RIGHT end of the keyboard. Feet should be separated by only the width of the keyboard, about HALF their current separation. Legs go from hips upward toward those sandals in a forward V. BOTH sandals must remain visible: left sandal peeking past the left side of her hair/wing, right sandal next to the keyboard's right corner. Total leg opening is approximately 70 degrees. Do not hide or omit a leg. Keep both frames identically posed except the existing small typing hand movement. Preserve the CRT desktop and complete transparent sprite sheet.
